name: BEARNDAO
fix_description: Restrict convertDustToEarned to authorized callers only (e.g. add onlyOperator or onlyStrategist modifier). The function is currently public with no access control, allowing anyone to trigger a swap of the strategy's wantToken balance to earnedToken at manipulated prices. Additionally, the swap uses amountOutMin=0 with no slippage protection — add an oracle-based or TWAP minimum output check to prevent execution at manipulated spot prices.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a very short, direct flash-loan-funded loop exploiting a broken deposit/emergencyWithdraw accounting path, with only two core protocol actions repeated and no complex routing, oracle manipulation, or deep multi-contract state reasoning. An experienced auditor could identify and script this in well under 30 minutes once reviewing the vulnerable vault logic.
